prompt:
Some people think that governments should spend most of their transport budget on buses and trains. Others believe that improving roads for cars and lorries brings greater benefits.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
instruction_line: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Write at least 250 words.
key_points: Both views must be addressed separately and in a balanced way
Reasons in favour of public transport: accessibility, less traffic, lower cost
Reasons in favour of road investment: freight transport, rural connections, places public transport cannot reach
The writer's own opinion must be clearly stated and follow from the reasons discussed
It can be stated under what condition the opinion applies (large city / sparsely populated area)
common_mistakes: Giving only one or two sentences to one of the two views
Never stating one's own opinion, or only hinting at it in the final sentence
Summarising both sides without making any comparison between them
